milestones.name: Bootstrap
milestones.summary: Repository, toolchain locks, ROM boundary, synthetic CI, and dashboard.
milestones.gate: All bootstrap checks pass without Nintendo-derived data.

milestones.name: Dual-CPU discovery
milestones.summary: Map reset paths, interrupts, traces, and initial S-CPU/SA-1 control flow.
milestones.gate: Repeatable traces and an address-correct initial CFG exist for both CPUs.

milestones.name: Lifter proof
milestones.summary: Verify instruction semantics and lift the first blocks.
milestones.gate: Registers, writes, and cycles match the scripted reference corpus.

milestones.name: Reset to first frame
milestones.summary: Execute translated code through the first rendered frame.
milestones.gate: Hardware events and the fixed first-frame checkpoint match.

milestones.name: Title and menus
milestones.summary: Make title, menus, input replay, and SRAM initialization interactive.
milestones.gate: All title/menu scenarios pass deterministic replay.

milestones.name: First playable room
milestones.summary: Run movement, collision, camera, enemies, helper, video, and audio.
milestones.gate: The first-room route passes state, pixel, and event checks.

milestones.name: Spring Breeze
milestones.summary: Complete Spring Breeze from start through credits.
milestones.gate: Required Spring Breeze routes pass, including helper and save flows.

milestones.name: Full content
milestones.summary: Cover all modes, minigames, unlocks, saves, and endings.
milestones.gate: Every required content scenario has current evidence.

milestones.name: Full parity
milestones.summary: Close fixed route corpus, fallbacks, unknown targets, and critical divergences.
milestones.gate: Zero required fallback, unknown executed target, or unexplained critical divergence.

milestones.name: Windows release candidate
milestones.summary: Produce a reproducible asset-free Windows x64 package.
milestones.gate: Clean-machine Windows acceptance and asset-boundary audit pass.

milestones.name: Native presentation experiments
milestones.summary: Add optional presentation paths behind parity-tested boundaries.
milestones.gate: Compatibility path remains green and selectable.

milestones.name: Linux delivery
milestones.summary: Validate Linux and package AppImage and Flatpak.
milestones.gate: Both packages pass external-ROM launch and save checks.

components.name: 65C816 decoder and lifter
components.summary: The full opcode/addressing metadata table is complete; execution semantics still require reference verification.

metrics.label: opcode definitions
metrics.note: Definition coverage only; this does not claim verified execution semantics.

components.name: Deterministic scheduler
components.summary: Stable master-clock event ordering exists; hardware synchronization semantics remain to be integrated.

metrics.label: synchronization classes
metrics.note: Interrupts, shared memory, DMA, timers, frames, APU ports, contention, and wait states.

components.name: S-CPU and SA-1 address spaces
components.summary: Synthetic mapping contracts cover the primary memories, mirrors, permissions, placeholders, and independent open-bus state.

metrics.label: synthetic mapping groups
metrics.note: WRAM, IRAM, BWRAM, ROM, hardware placeholders, permissions, and open bus. Hardware-reference verification remains separate.

components.name: PPU, DMA, APU, input, and save
components.summary: Hardware backend integration has not started.

components.name: Differential validator
components.summary: Evidence runner and normalized checkpoint comparison are planned.

metrics.label: passing required scenarios
metrics.note: Seed suite only; route inventory expands with discovered behavior.

components.name: Windows package
components.summary: The Windows C++ runtime and tests build cleanly; packaging and gameplay execution remain outstanding.

components.name: Linux portability
components.summary: Compilation is maintained early; packaging follows Windows RC.
